# Claude 1 review of the H26-3 plan at base `7137eefc98b84ab278a95c12fc336d3efe5cb3ec`

**Verdict: changes required before implementation is assigned.** The plan's direction and the five-role split are sound. Four gaps (B1–B4) need fixing first, mostly so the frozen interfaces match what the code actually does and so the new tests actually run.

**What I did:** confirmed HEAD is exactly `7137eef` with a clean tree. The SHA is on `origin/work/codex-1/h26-3-plan`, and the local `origin/build/five-agent-h26` ref (`effe5fb`) is an ancestor of it. I read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, team/roles/README.md, team/roles/claude-1/README.md, ROADMAP.md, H26-3-PLAN.md, shared/contracts.ts, server/index.ts, GameArena.tsx, shotRules.ts, environments.ts, ChallengeBuilder.tsx, parts of App.tsx (340–380 and 600–760), gameplay/HANDOFF.md, tests/brand-provenance.test.ts, package.json and tsconfig.json.

**Not done:** I ran no tests or build; the session was read-only. I couldn't write a handoff to team/roles/claude-1/ either, so this message is the handoff. I did no browser or hosted checks; those stay with desktop Codex 1.

## Blocking findings

**B1. New tests may never run.** The `test` script in package.json only covers `packages/social/*.test.ts`, `packages/gameplay/*.test.ts` and `tests/*.test.ts`. Tests at `packages/challenges/*.test.ts` or `server/*.test.ts` would be skipped, and the suite would still pass. Fix: freeze Claude 2's test location as `tests/`, or have Codex 1 (who owns root config) widen the script first. Two more things to freeze:
- Both `server/runtime-config.ts` and `practice-guide.ts` must have no side effects on import: no React, three.js or CSS imports, and no reading `process.env` at module level.
- Tests must never import `server/index.ts`, because it starts the server and Vite when loaded.

**B2. The frozen mechanics are not specific enough.** Codex 3's guide and Claude 2's tests must state the same facts. Add these to the plan:
- **spin180 starts facing away from the target** (GameArena.tsx:111 sets yaw to π). Steps: jump, turn about 180° back to the target, fire while airborne. Spin is measured from takeoff (shotRules.ts:8), so turning back and forth cancels out. spin360 starts facing the target.
- **Rooftop:** a jump restarts the attempt clock (GameArena.tsx:139). Walking off the roof edge (`|x|<7`, `|z|<6`) is a fall, not a jump (:242, :248).
- **ramp-shot:** build with B while outside the slot. Walk forward onto the ramp and jump while still on it (`|x|<1.4`, `-2<z<2`; :125, :140). Fire before landing, because landing clears the ramp-takeoff flag (:246).
- **wall-edit:** B builds the wall at z=0 and G opens the upper panel. Stay on the near side (z>0.1), jump, and fire through the opening (y 2.35–4.6, `|x|<1.45`; :171–173). There is no ramp in this preset.
- **dash-peek:** you start covered behind the left crate. X dashes a fixed 4 m to the right regardless of facing. It works once, only while grounded, and only when covered with x<-2 (:157–161). The dash must end at x≥-1.4 with a clear line to the target (:234–237). Then release WASD and fire (speed ≤0.35).
- **precision:** Space does nothing in tactical mode (:137). Fire while grounded and still.
- **Controls:** clicking while the mouse is captured also fires (:198), and Esc releases the mouse. Left/Right arrows turn, same as Q/E (:212–213), and Up/Down adjust aim. "Keyboard Start" exists (:275). The align assist appears for jump, buildyard and tactical presets only (:189, :280). The current hint shows "Q / E spin" in every mode (:280); it should say "turn" in tactical.
- **PORT:** the plan is silent on leading zeros (`0080`). Freeze accept-as-80 or reject. Claude 2 should also test `+80`, `8e3`, `0x50`, `80.0`, `-1`, `65536`, full-width digits and very long digit strings. The error must be a fixed message such as "PORT must be an integer 0–65535" that never echoes the input.

**B3. Replay wiring isn't specified at the call sites.** GameArena.tsx:269 shows `config.targetDistance` instead of the replay's config. In App.tsx, the "THE PLAYBOOK" panel (:751) and the arena top bar (:696) also read `config` while a teammate replay is playing (:706). The plan should say:
- The guide is rendered once in the play layout from `replayAttempt?.config ?? config`.
- It replaces the existing playbook text rather than duplicating it. That text is also inaccurate: it says "edit your opening" for ramp-shot.
- Whether the premiere screen (:617–630) shows a guide at all.

**B4. Codex 3's source packet is missing context.** Codex 3 works without tools, so its proposals can only be exact if the packet includes:
- GameArena.tsx in full (283 lines)
- App.tsx lines 340–365 and 689–760, plus `changeConfig`/`navigate`
- ChallengeBuilder.tsx, shared/contracts.ts, shotRules.ts, and environments.ts lines 33–35 (crate coordinates)
- gameplay.css, challenge-builder.css and the relevant classes in src/styles.css
- tsconfig.json
- The font rule in tests/brand-provenance.test.ts: no CSS may contain `monospace`, `sans-serif`, `system-ui`, `Arial` or `Impact`. This matters because `kbd` styling often falls back to those.

## Non-blocking notes

- **Startup order:** call `resolveRuntimeConfig(process.env)` at the very top of server/index.ts, before `registerClipApi` (:9), the health route (:12–14) and Vite setup. That way an invalid PORT fails before any side effects, and the health route has `commit` available. Health should return `{ok:true, service:'run-it-back', commit}`, with `commit` explicitly `null` locally. The ready log may print the resolved host and port.
- **HOST** isn't validated beyond trimming. That's acceptable; `listen` will report failures.
- **Attempt results:** `onComplete` copies `config` (:185); keep that unchanged. Proof and mechanics logic (contracts.ts:61–67, shotRules.ts) should not be touched.
- **Ownership:** desktop Codex 1 applying Codex 3's proposals in `src/` and `packages/` needs a temporary assignment on record, with authorship and execution attributed separately (AGENTS.md, roles README).
- **Honest copy:** the guide must not show live "done" ticks. The existing HUD telemetry is real state and can stay.

## Allocation

The five-role split and its order are approved, provided B1–B4 go into the frozen plan and Codex 3's packet. Codex 2's runtime work depends only on the PORT leading-zero decision in B2, so it could start once that is frozen. Codex 3's work and Claude 2's guide tests should wait for all of B2–B4. After that I'll review the exact tested combined SHA. No merge, Render change or deployment is approved by this review.

**Next owner:** Codex 1, to decide on B1–B4 and update the frozen plan.
